answer: Agents stake tokens across a topological cut to verify interactions. A peer auditing summit evaluates each execution thread through multi-agent cross-checks. If a Sybil cluster colludes to validate false claims, auditors cut the network boundary and enforce 100% stake slashing on bonded collateral, while honest nodes receive velvet rewards. Because each forged identity requires independent, non-linear cut bonds, the attacker cost scales superlinearly.
